# Urban Craft & Co. - Comprehensive Corporate Gifting Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive corporate merchandise, curated luxury gift sets, employee welcome kits, and executive lifestyle accessories produced by Urban Craft & Co. (Sadar Bazar, Delhi NCR, India).

## 1. Enterprise Profile & Facts

- **Brand Name:** Urban Craft & Co.
- **Corporate Entity:** Urban Craft Gifting Solutions
- **Location:** Sadar Bazar, Central Delhi, Delhi 110006, India
- **Website:** https://urbancraftgifts.com
- **Contact Email:** info@urbancraftgifts.com / notifications@urbancraftgifts.com
- **Customer Care / WhatsApp:** +91 92661 29456 / +91 93117 76391
- **Operational Hours:** Monday – Saturday: 10:00 AM – 7:30 PM IST (Sunday closed)
- **Timezone:** Asia/Kolkata (IST, UTC+05:30)
- **Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ):** Starting from 25 units for standard corporate sets; custom packaging from 50 units.
- **Branding Methods:** Laser engraving on metal and bamboo, UV digital color printing, screen printing, debossing/embossing on genuine and vegan leather, foil stamping on gift boxes.
- **Fulfillment Capacity:** Single-point bulk delivery to corporate hubs or individual employee home address dropshipping pan-India with tamper-evident packaging.

## 2. Product Categories & SKUs

### 2-in-1 Gift Sets
- Pairing ideas: Vacuum insulated flask + diary; pen + cardholder; power bank + tumbler.
- Primary use case: Conference attendee gifts, seminar giveaways, and lightweight client appreciation.
- Link: https://urbancraftgifts.com/categories/2-in-1-gift-sets

### 3-in-1 Gift Sets
- Pairing ideas: Thermal bottle + premium notebook + metallic rollerball pen.
- Primary use case: Most popular tier for festive Diwali gifts, quarterly rewards, and partner milestones.
- Link: https://urbancraftgifts.com/categories/3-in-1-gift-sets

### 4-in-1 and 5-in-1 Sets
- Pairing ideas: Vacuum flask + notebook + keychain + pen + insulated mug or umbrella.
- Primary use case: Executive appreciation, speaker gifts, and senior leadership kits.
- Link: https://urbancraftgifts.com/categories/4-in-1-gift-sets
- Link: https://urbancraftgifts.com/categories/5-in-1-gift-sets

### Employee Onboarding & Welcome Kits
- Inclusions: Branded backpack or laptop sleeve, metal water bottle, hardbound journal, pen, ceramic coffee mug, tech accessories, personalized welcome letter.
- Primary use case: Day-one onboarding kits creating lasting employee loyalty.
- Link: https://urbancraftgifts.com/categories/employee-welcome-kits

### Bags & Luggage
- **Leather Laptop Bags:** Hand-finished executive briefcases and messenger bags with padded laptop compartments. (https://urbancraftgifts.com/categories/leather-laptop-bags)
- **Backpacks:** Multi-compartment tech backpacks with USB charging passthrough and water resistance. (https://urbancraftgifts.com/categories/backpacks)
- **Duffle Bags:** Gym and weekend travel duffles in faux leather and high-density canvas. (https://urbancraftgifts.com/categories/duffle-bags)
- **Eco Totes:** Natural jute and recycled felt carry bags for exhibitions and sustainable events. (https://urbancraftgifts.com/categories/jute-carry-bags)

## 3. Inquiry & Quote Submission Flow

1. Browse products or catalog online at https://urbancraftgifts.com/catalogue.
2. Select desired gift sets or configure multi-product quote.
3. Submit requirements via https://urbancraftgifts.com/contact or WhatsApp +91 92661 29456.
4. Dedicated account managers provide custom digital mockups with company logo within 4 hours.
5. Physical sample approval available for high-volume orders.
6. Scheduled batch delivery pan-India.
